code_examples.section: ltm rule command BOTDEFENSE bot signature
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature
       Returns the name of the detected Bot Signature.

SYNOPSIS
       BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the name of the detected Bot Signature, or an empty string if no bot signature was detected.

       Syntax

       BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the name of the detected Bot Signature, or an empty string if no bot signature was detected.

VALID DURING
       BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST, BOTDEFENSE_ACTION

EXAMPLES
	# EXAMPLE: Log the bot signature.
	when BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST {
	    set log "botdefense bot_signature is"
	    append log " [BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature]"
	    HSL::send $hsl $log
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
